info.title: Deft Collection API
info.description: The Deft collection endpoint: per-installation registration/opt-in/opt-out, single-use challenge nonces, and scoped event submission.

post.summary: Register a new installation and receive its install token.

parameters.name: X-Deft-Deployment
parameters.description: The caller's deployment identity, `product:platform:environment:version[:customer]` (DEP-1). Required on every request; missing or malformed values are rejected with `deployment_invalid` before any per-installation state is touched.

parameters.name: X-Deft-Correlator
parameters.description: Optional opaque install-cluster correlator (CORR-1..CORR-3). When present on a POST it must match the body `correlator` field byte-for-byte; a malformed value is rejected with `correlator_invalid` before any per-installation state is touched.

201.description: Register a new installation and receive its install token.

default.description: The request was rejected. `error` is one of the closed error codes documented in the `x-error-codes` root extension of this document, alongside its status and a human-readable explanation of the cause and remedy.

correlator.description: Optional install-cluster correlator (CORR-3). When present must equal the X-Deft-Correlator header byte-for-byte.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The shared error envelope every rejected request returns.

pointer.description: Optional JSON-pointer-ish path into the request body, for schema_invalid.

InstallationToken.description: The per-installation Installation token. Returned exactly once, in the response body of POST /v1/registrations, and never retrievable again afterward — it is not an API key and is not shared across installations. Losing it means registering a new installation. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <install_token>` on every request except registration itself.

invalid_json.description: The request body could not be parsed as JSON. Check for truncated or malformed payload text before resending.

unsupported_media_type.description: The Content-Type header was missing or was not application/json. Send the body as JSON with that exact content type.

payload_too_large.description: The request body exceeded the size cap for this scope. Trim the payload (e.g. shorten logs or stack traces) and retry.

schema_invalid.description: The JSON body did not match the schema this route expects. The pointer field, when present, names the offending key; fix the payload shape and retry.

token_missing.description: No bearer token was supplied. Include an Authorization header of the form 'Bearer <install_token>'.

token_mismatch.description: The supplied bearer token does not match this installation's stored token. Re-register to obtain a fresh token.

unknown_installation.description: The install_id in the request does not correspond to any known installation. Register a new installation before retrying.

not_opted_in.description: This installation has not completed opt-in for any scope yet. Call the optin endpoint before requesting a challenge or submitting data.

optin_expired.description: The installation's opt-in window has expired. The client must opt in again before it can submit further data.

scope_not_consented.description: The installation has opted in, but not for this particular scope. Call optin again including this scope.

revoked.description: This installation has opted out and can no longer submit data. Register a new installation to resume sending data.

nonce_invalid.description: The supplied nonce is not recognized for this installation and scope. Request a fresh challenge and retry with its nonce.

nonce_expired.description: The nonce expired before it was used. Request a fresh challenge and submit promptly afterward.

nonce_used.description: This nonce has already been consumed by an earlier submission. Request a new challenge for every submission attempt.

nonce_scope_mismatch.description: The nonce was issued for a different scope than the one being submitted. Request a challenge for the correct scope.

nonce_install_mismatch.description: The nonce was issued to a different installation than the one presenting it. Use the challenge issued to this installation's token.

duplicate.description: An event with this exact content was already accepted for this installation and scope. The duplicate was acknowledged but not enqueued again.

rate_limited.description: The caller has been rate-limited. Back off and retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.

quota_exceeded.description: This installation's daily submission quota has been used up. Retry after the Retry-After header's duration, once the next UTC day begins.

too_many_nonces.description: Too many outstanding challenge nonces exist for this installation and scope already. Wait for the Retry-After duration before requesting another.

scope_disabled.description: This scope has been disabled via the operator kill switch. Submissions for it are rejected until an operator re-enables it.

service_disabled.description: The entire collection service has been disabled via the global kill switch. All submissions are rejected until an operator re-enables it.

denied.description: This installation is on the deny list and is blocked from issuing challenges or submitting data. Contact the service operator if this is unexpected.

method_not_allowed.description: The HTTP method used is not supported on this route. Check the API reference for the correct verb for this path.

not_found.description: The requested route or scope does not exist. Check the URL path and, for submissions, the scope name for typos.

internal_error.description: An unexpected server error occurred and the request was not processed. Retry later, or contact support if it keeps happening.

already_registered.description: A registration already exists for the derived identity. Reuse the existing install_id and install_token instead of registering again.

https_required.description: The request was made over plain HTTP. Resend the exact same request over HTTPS instead.

deployment_invalid.description: The X-Deft-Deployment header was missing or did not match the required product:platform:environment:version[:customer] grammar. Fix the header value and retry.

deployment_mismatch.description: The deployment_id field in the request body did not exactly match the X-Deft-Deployment header. Make sure both carry the identical value.

correlator_invalid.description: The X-Deft-Correlator header or body correlator field did not match the required lowercase alphanumeric-and-hyphen grammar. Fix the value and retry.

correlator_mismatch.description: The correlator was present in only one of the header or body, or the two values disagreed. Send identical X-Deft-Correlator and body correlator values, or omit both.
